task1.title: Percentage of households in owned and rented accommodation, England and Wales, 1918 to 2011
task1.prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of households in owned and rented accommodation in England and Wales between 1918 and 2011.

chartDesc.title: Households owning and renting accommodation in England and Wales 1918 to 2011
chartDesc.overview: Over the period, the proportion of households in owned accommodation grew overall to surpass rented accommodation, which showed an opposite downward trend. This pattern slightly reversed in 2011.
keyFeatures: In 1918, rented accommodation was at its highest percentage (77%) while home ownership was at its lowest (23%).
By 1971, both owned and rented accommodation reached equal proportions at 50% each.
Owned accommodation peaked in 2001 at 69% before dropping slightly to 64% in 2011.
Rented accommodation hit its lowest point in 2001 at 31% before rising to 36% in 2011.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
